newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Sell-offs, precious metals to raise Russia revenue.
newsitem.headline: Sell-offs, precious metals to raise Russia revenue.

text.p: Russia, strapped for cash after dismal first quarter revenues, will adopt a new approach to share sales, privatisation and the precious metal market to raise 30 trillion roubles ($5 billion), First Deputy Prime Minister Anatoly Chubais said on Thursday.

"We need an emergency revenue programme to bring in 30 trillion roubles," Chubais told the Federation Council upper house of parliament. "This will be through new approaches to the precious metals market, the equities market, the alcohol monopoly and highly efficient privatisation projects."

It was not clear exactly how Chubais, who has already targeted higher privatisation revenues this year, expects to raise money from precious metals, but sales of gold and diamonds are traditionally a way to bring money to state coffers.
